findings.evidence: Line 8 imports `TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.JordanChevalley.Functoriality`; its only use is `isUnipotent_congrLinearEquiv_iff` at line 151, while that theorem itself concerns arbitrary commutative-ring modules and no Jordan decomposition.
findings.fix: Move `isUnipotent_congrLinearEquiv_iff` into this module (and have `JordanChevalley/Functoriality.lean` import it), then remove this import; ideally move the `IsUnipotent` definition and its identity lemma here from `JordanChevalley/Multiplicative.lean` as well.
findings.issue: This elementary general-linear-group module imports `JordanChevalley.Functoriality` solely for conjugation invariance, making the foundational unipotence API depend on later Jordan-decomposition theory.

summary: The general unipotence API has an inverted dependency on the later Jordan–Chevalley theory.
